entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I need to return something. I'm a bit confused about the process. I have this helmet here.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I please have your order number?
Oh, right. It's... VF-86753. I've had it for a little while, I'm just not sure what to do. I feel a bit overwhelmed.
Not a problem at all. I've pulled up your order for the Aero Road Helmet. Thank you. To make sure I'm helping correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
No, it's not broken or anything. The box is unopened. It's just... the color wasn't what I expected from the website. I feel silly about it. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I can help. It's completely understandable that the color might look different in person. And your safety is what matters most, so having a helmet you're happy to wear is important. Let me just check the return eligibility for you.
Okay... I hope it's not too late.
Alright, I've checked our policy. I see here that the item was delivered 68 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window for standard items.
Oh, really? So... so I can send it back?

Yes, absolutely. Since the box is unopened and it's within the timeframe, I can process this return for a full refund right now. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file. You can just print that out and attach it to the package.
Wow, that's such a relief! Thank you so much, Sarah. I was so worried it would be complicated.
You're very welcome. We try to make it as easy as possible. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
